changelog:
Initial release of graph-skill.

- Introduces a dependency graph-based workflow for coding tasks with local quality gates, parallel agents, caching, retries, and resume support.
- Provides an interactive local ASCII and HTML report for each execution.
- Supports initialization, node management, task planning, cache usage, and quality validation via CLI commands.
- Enforces tier-based protocol sizing (S, M, L) based on files, open design decisions, and cross-cutting risks.
- Logs token usage when available and safeguards against unrequested pushes, deployments, or PRs.
summary: Execute coding work as a cached dependency graph with local quality gates, parallel agents, localized retries, resume support, token telemetry, and an interactive report. Use for /graph requests.
